Abort during reference-attention chunked prefill is not honoured on e2b3b7ec0 for CommitKV as well, so this is not specific to PyramidKV. The held b768 runs aborted cleanly at 600 s because their prefill (377-559 s) had already finished; PyramidKV's 67k-token prefill had not, which wedged the server.

A deadline shorter than a request's prefill therefore turns a task-level timeout into an engine-wide stall; the deadline must exceed the longest prefill, or the engine abort path must stop between prefill chunks.
